biggest_catch: Per-referral reward differs by account type the friend opens ($150 personal vs $50 business), and the $500 annual cap applies; the page notes the 'increased reward offer is subject to change at any time'.
catches: Referrer earns a $150 Visa Reward Card per individual referred (personal checking) or $50 per business referred (business checking).
Referrer cap: up to $500 value in Visa Reward Cards per calendar year.

Referred friend must register, open the new checking account, and complete $400+ in card purchases and $500+ in direct deposits/automatic credits within 60 days, with account open and in good standing at least 60 days.
Allow 4-6 weeks after completion of all requirements for delivery of the Visa Reward Card.
Provident employees are not eligible to refer; youth checking ineligible; 18+ only.

steps: Register for Provident's Member Referral Program on providentcu.org.
Share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers.
Your friend registers with your link, opens a new personal (or business) checking account.
Friend completes $400+ in card purchases and $500+ in direct deposits within 60 days, with account open and in good standing at least 60 days.
You receive a $150 Visa Reward Card (individual) or $50 (business) within 4-6 weeks of all requirements being met.
